properties.description: Synchronous reset clears both response valids after the reset edge; pre-reset presentations are not incorrectly suppressed.
A blocked data response retains valid, byte and last across the edge unless reset cancels it.
A blocked status response retains valid and every status field independently of data readiness.
Every presented data byte is justified by the accepted input prefix in frame order, preserving the first eight bytes and inserting only completion-justified zero padding.
Every presented status belongs to the next completed accepted input frame and reports its original length, clamped length, padding and truncation correctly.
Presented data has last exactly on the adjusted frame boundary; an incomplete prefix cannot justify an early last. Data and status advance independently and reset starts a fresh epoch.
